utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive—what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo. If you can bring a few sturdy boxes and some packing tape, that would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll bring a few sturdy boxes and packing tape.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m a little worried about the timing and drop-off details—do we know where the repair drive is being held? If you’ve got the logistics, I can help sort it out.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Do we know the exact location for the repair drive, or is that still up in the air?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I don’t know the exact spot yet, so I’d rather confirm it before we tell anyone. Once we have the address, I can help line up the drop-off details.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. What’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — sorry, I keep mixing up the details. I haven’t heard a fresh update yet, but I can check with the folks organizing it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, that’d help. I’ve been a bit out of the loop lately, so just let me know when you hear back.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—just tell me what needs doing, and I’ll pass the plan along.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Vik — could you share the list of items and the drop-off time? I’ll spread the word while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure — send me the item list and drop-off time, and I’ll pass it along to everyone.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Gus, sorry I’m late — how’s the repair drive going?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No worries, Dane — it’s going well. I’ve got a few tools ready if anyone needs them.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Nice, that’s helpful — I can lend a hand and maybe grab a few more supplies if you need.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good—what time are we doing the repair drive, and what should I bring?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Let’s do it Saturday at 10 by the community shed. Bring gloves, a screwdriver if you’ve got one, and maybe a water bottle.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Saturday at 10 by the community shed works for me. I’ll bring gloves, a screwdriver, and water.

utterances.text: Mina: Hi Sam — what time is the repair drive, and do you need any help with it?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hi Mina — it starts at 10 a.m. at the community center, and yes, I could really use a hand setting up.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — I can help set up. What should I bring?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help connect folks for the repair drive—want me to spread the word with the different groups?

utterances.speaker: Opal

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll reach out to the different groups and send folks your way. I’ll let you know who’s interested and where they’re coming from.

utterances.speaker: Mara

utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara — we still need a few volunteers for check-in, someone to sort donated supplies, and a couple people to help with pickups. If you’re willing, I can put you where you’d be most useful.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help with pickups or sorting donated supplies—whichever you need most. Put me where I’ll be most useful.

utterances.speaker: Cleo

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Cleo — I’ll check what’s missing and send you a quick list.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect — send it over when you can, and I’ll keep it organized.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I heard the repair drive is getting more volunteers than expected—pretty good news for the block! I can pass along the sign-up details if you want.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’s great to hear—thanks, Tess. Please do pass along the sign-up details.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely—sign-up is at the community center front desk, or you can text me and I’ll send the link. They’re also looking for folks with tools, but any help is welcome.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Ira — keep me posted, and I’ll help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Vik

utterances.speaker: Vik

utterances.speaker: Uli

utterances.speaker: Noah

utterances.speaker: Rey

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can bring a screwdriver set and lend a hand for a bit. Just tell me where to show up.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll get the repair drive organized and keep everyone updated. Let’s make sure we’ve got the list and the supplies lined up.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great — I’ll keep track of who’s coming and where the supplies are stored.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Opal — I’ll draft the list and confirm the supplies so we’re ready to go.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d like to know the timing and where the repairs will be staged first.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll get the timing and staging spot nailed down and pass it along right away.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, I’d appreciate that. Once you know, please send me the details so I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You’re sure the repair drive is still happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Let me check the details first, but I believe it’s still on.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, please confirm it before I tell anyone else.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m happy to help, Dane. Just tell me the plan for the repair drive and I’ll stick to it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Eli — I’m still sorting the details, but I’ll let you know the plan as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Alright, Dane — just keep me posted, and I’ll be ready when you are.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sure thing—I’ll bring tape, gloves, and a couple trash bags.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I can help out; just remind me what you still need me to bring.

utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Oren — we still need a hammer, some screwdrivers, and a few boxes of nails. If you can bring those, that would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — I’ll bring a hammer, some screwdrivers, and a few boxes of nails. If I forget, give me a nudge again and I’ll sort it out.

utterances.speaker: Faye

utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Oren — I’m still piecing it together from what folks have said, so let me get the list and I’ll point you to the biggest needs.

utterances.speaker: Oren

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can help keep an eye on supplies for the repair drive—what do you need me to watch for?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Cleo — mainly tools, screws, and any extra paint if you spot it. I’m a bit scattered today, so just let me know if anything looks low.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: You got it—I’ll watch for tools, screws, and extra paint, and I’ll let you know right away if anything’s running low.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive—what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Leo — could you bring your drill and a box of screws? That’d help a ton.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll bring my drill and a box of screws.

utterances.text: Mara: Hi Sam — I’m glad we’re finally talking about the repair drive. What’s the first thing you need help with?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Mara — thanks for helping. First thing, I need someone to help sort the donated tools and check what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I can sort the donated tools and make a list of what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So the repair drive is still happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yep, it’s still happening — I’m helping keep things moving and making sure everyone hears about it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just checking — it’s still on for now, then?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good—let’s keep it simple and go step by step. What time are you thinking for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: How about Saturday morning around 10? That should give folks plenty of time to swing by.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds like a good start—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Opal

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Opal — I’d appreciate that. If you hear anything, let me know and I’ll spread the word while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can bring what I have for the repair drive. Just let me know what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Uli — I’ll check what’s still missing and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Bo. I appreciate it — just let me know when you’ve checked.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around school drop-off and pickup. What time is the repair drive starting?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Faye — it starts at 9 a.m. I really appreciate you helping with the school times.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 9 a.m. works — I can do drop-off first and swing by after pickup if needed. Just tell me where you want me to meet you.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and keep everyone posted on the plan.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Vik — that would help a lot. I’ll keep the plan tidy and send you any updates as they come in.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll keep sharing the updates and make sure everyone stays in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did you already decide what needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Not yet, but I’m gathering a quick list from the block now. If you spot anything, send it my way and I’ll add it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I’ll keep an eye out and send you anything I notice.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m in, but I’d like to know the exact time and where we’re meeting first. If we’re coordinating the repair drive, I just want to make sure the details are settled.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I’m in too — can you send the exact time and meeting spot? I tend to join a bit late, so I don’t want to miss the handoff.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Sure — I’ll send the exact time and meeting spot as soon as they’re confirmed, so we can keep the handoff smooth.
